about_the_game:
About This Game

ALIEN ATTORNEY ADVENTURE is a high-stakes legal thriller where the courtroom is a battlefield and you are the only shield between your client and oblivion.

On the harsh colony world of Ambearth, the justice system is broken. As a public defender, you don’t get the easy cases. You get the desperate ones. The lost causes. The monsters. Your job isn’t to judge them—it’s to save them.

Why You’ll Care (The Fantasy)

  • Confront the Abyss: Satisfy your morbid curiosity from the safety of the defense table. Dive into crimes that are violent, bizarre, and terrifyingly human.

  • The Ultimate Whodunit: You aren't just watching a mystery—you're solving it. Cross-examine unreliable witnesses, expose police bias, and find the singular crack in the prosecution's "perfect" story.

  • The High of High Stakes: Feel the adrenaline of a "Not Guilty" verdict. In a world of chaos, you are the force that restores order.

  • Defenda est Veritas: Use actual legal mechanics—Voir Dire, Brady motions, and exclusionary rules—to dismantle the state's case.

  • Survive the System: Manage your caseload, your ethics, and your sanity. Every plea deal is a gamble; every trial is a war.

What You’ll Do

  • Interrogate: Break down liars on the stand.

  • Investigate: Find the evidence the cops "missed."

  • Litigate: Object, argue, and persuade.

Core Loop

  • Preparation: Review the file, find the holes.

  • Investigation: Hit the streets, find the truth.

  • Trial: Enter the arena and fight.

Tone

Mature, psychological, and grounded. A tribute to the defenders who stand in the gap.

content_descriptors.notes: The court process has to get into deep subjects that can be triggering to some. Sexual violence in not in the game nor-will it be added. That was one part of my job I hated the most.
